Strategy: Scale both the sweet-band reward and the mid penalty down to fifteen and gate the sweet band behind at least five open bins, combining the gentlest steering with the best gate. This keeps most Best Fit behavior intact, but the smaller adjustments may rarely change any ranking.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
